description: This Java class `InvalidateCacheEntry` represents a command used internally within a concierge service to signal cache invalidation for a specific entity identified by `EntityIdWithResourceType`. It provides methods for creating instances from an entity ID or JSON, converting to JSON, and standard overrides for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: InvalidateCacheEntry
classes.description: Represents a command to invalidate a cache entry for a specific entity, with JSON serialization/deserialization and equality support.

methods.description: Creates an InvalidateCacheEntry instance from a JsonObject.

methods.name: getEntityId

methods.description: Serializes the cache invalidation command to a JsonObject.
